value: Catalog choice by number of clients
quote: If you would like to perform local data warehousing with a single client, use DuckDB as the catalog database. If you would like to perform local data warehousing using multiple local clients, use SQLite as the catalog database. If you would like to operate a multi-user lakehouse with potentially remote clients, use PostgreSQL as the catalog database.
source_title: DuckLake docs: Choosing a Catalog Database
notes: The demo used a DuckDB catalog, i.e. the single-client setup.

value: SQLite catalog: one writer with retries
quote: SQLite allows only one writer at a time. DuckLake retries lock conflicts when using a SQLite catalog. This allows a reasonable amount of multi-processing support

notes: SQLite is supported for multiple local clients; not tested in the logged demo.
